wordpress.owes: the field; the track is named Carousel when there is no heading today

fields.name: source
fields.label: Show
fields.description: Only the collections the site has installed are offered.

wordpress.owes: the source select: scroll_carousel becomes source inline, a testimonials layout set to slider becomes source testimonials; the other collections are new
wordpress.note: COLLISION: salt-wordpress's query control already stores a sub-field named source meaning the query MODE (default|taxonomy|manual, inc/query/controls.php), at the same level this field is stored. A migration must read the old source into the query's mode (manual keeps its picked items) before it writes this field, or manual selections are lost and a half-migrated row reads 'manual' as a collection. The formerly names here are LAYOUT slugs, not field names: the layout a row was stored under gives its source.
